limits: Simulated DOM only; no browser certification
Two minimal patterns, not all possible synchronization designs
Raw direct store writes in this fixture deliberately have no named Lit notification
Inheritance/upgrade/compiler/CEM/React cases not executed in this probe
findings: Both patterns pass the nine after-update checks.
Direct accessors preserve immediate public/store agreement and canonical state while rendering is gated.
The willUpdate copying pattern does not preserve those immediate guarantees.
TanStack rendering notifications alone do not reflect store-origin changes into public attributes.
next: Design and test complete notification coverage without creating a second state owner. Retain standard Lit property metadata; do not assume a custom decorator is supported by CEM.
